lines.en: I knock on Uta’s door and make a silent promise to myself that I am going to be more normal today than I was during our fake date at the park.
But, in order to do that, I’m going to need her to answer the door as I can’t exactly be “normal” while standing in the middle of the hall and blankly staring at it.
Then again, I could just go in.
But that hasn’t exactly worked out well in the past.
At least...not by any standard definition of the word “well.”
I did get to see boobs, though.
And getting to see Uta’s-
And getting to see the almost fully grown version of Uta’s sure sounds like it would be nice.
I’m just going to go inside.
There’s no one here.
I’m alone in Uta and Io’s room and there is no one here.
I can do anything I want.
I can do anything I want.
: Hah...I really needed this. Between all that extra course work and the time I’ve been putting into archery, my back and my head are friggin’ killing me.
: Having a best friend who works at a bath house is something everybody needs to put on their to-do list. This is the life, Io. This is the life.
: It is certainly a life, Uta. But this particular bath house girl is all booked up on friends, so “everyone else” is going to have to look elsewhere for their free bath benefits.
: Or, you know, just bathe at home and leave people like me out of the equation altogether.

: Your anti-socialness is ruining my bath. If you’re going to talk, keep it to stuff like, “You’re the best, Uta!” Or, “You’re so pretty and your grades are going to get better soon and everyone will love you!”
: If grades had any impact on how much a person was liked, Nodoka would have more people to talk to than the fat girl and her lesbian companions.
: That was mean. What has Futaba ever done to you?
: Nothing. And that did sound rude. I just forgot her name and wasn’t sure what else to call her.
: The nice one? The one who’s always reading? The library girl? The one who smells like lavender all the time? Even just “Nodoka’s friend” would have been fine.
: Now you’re ruining my bath. And you understood what I meant, so I don’t see what the big deal is.

: The “big deal” is that we’ve been in Sensei’s class for over two years now and you’re still the same Io you’ve always been. Would it really kill ya to just not be mean to people until they do something to you?
: Maybe. People have an easier time taking advantage of you once you start opening up to them. If I never do that, it greatly limits the opportunities people will have to ruin my life.
: I’ve decided Miku is fine, though. She’s not as bad as I thought she’d be. Plus, I don’t think she’s smart enough to actually hurt anybody.
: Are you guys still hanging out? I kinda figured you’d have gotten fed up with her by now. She talks even more than I do.
: She does. But you two are a lot alike in a bunch of ways, so maybe I’m just...predisposed to dealing with that type of girl?
: And...what type is that exactly?
: I don’t know. Loudmouth ex-tomboy looking to get in touch with her feminine side for reasons beyond Io-comprehension?
: That’s a really specific answer for apparently not knowing.
: Yeah, I guess it is.
: Also, I’m pretty sure Miku isn’t trying to abandon her tomboy side like I did. She’s just...also trying to do other stuff.
: You haven’t abandoned it either. You’re the ace of the kyudo club and you have a pet beetle. Those aren’t exactly the most “girly” traits out there, Uta.
: I wouldn’t mind if you changed stuff like your wardrobe or the music you listen to, though. That would be the ideal setup for me.
: There’s a problem with my wardrobe now?
: Too many bright colors. And like half of your bras have hearts on them. I don’t get it.
: You don’t get it because you’re anti-cute and don’t even wear a bra half the time.

: Why would I? It’s not like I’ve got anything to keep in check. The only reason I wear one with my uniform is because it’s uncomfortable if I don’t. But if I’m at work or home or something, what’s the point?
: What I fail to understand is why you need hearts or strawberries or other stuff like that on your underwear unless you’re showing it off to other people. Which-

: Wait. Nope. Gonna just catch myself right there and clarify that I wasn’t insinuating what it sounded like I was insinuating. That was, like...a generalization. Not a specifically-tailored Uta-based comment on-
: I know what you meant. Besides, it’s not like I even have the liberty to show anyone anything now that my phone’s locked.
: If I wanted to do that, it’d have to be in-person, and that’s...kind of...yeah.
: I just like feeling cute. That’s really what it comes down to.
: Uta...I’m sorry. You know I’m bad at thinking before I speak and I wasn’t trying to bring that up right-
: You know...it’s kind of good that you did, though.
: Uh...why is it good that I did?
: Because if you didn’t, I’d have to.
: I got another one the other day. From another different number.
: Seriously?...
: And I don’t even remember taking this one.
: How does this keep happening? Your phone’s supposed to block all picture messages, isn’t it? Can’t you complain to the carrier or something?
: And say what? Hello, Mr. Verizon- somebody keeps sending me nudes I took of myself when I was a kid. Can you make it stop, please?
: You don’t have to be that...direct about it.
: It’s fine. I’ll just get another new phone. That normally stops it for a month or two.
: What if you just, like...stop using a phone altogether?
: In 2020? How would I keep in touch with my parents? Carrier pigeon?
: You could use my phone to call them. And all of your friends live in the same building, so it’s not like you’d be missing out on contact with any of them.
: Something tells me doing that would just end up with you getting those pictures instead of me. And that’s not a thing I want for either one of us.
: Ugh...how many is that this month?
: Nine...I think.
: Five if we’re not counting duplicates.
: God fucking damn it. Maybe it really is time for a new phone then. That’s way more frequent than normal.
: It sure is...
: Whoever is doing this to you is fucking disgusting, Uta. I’m sorry you keep having to deal with it.
: As long as nobody else finds out, it’s...it’s fine, I guess. It’s obviously not like I haven’t seen myself naked before, so...yeah.
: Fucking...ugh. Literally nothing good ever comes from anything sexual. It’s all just fucking gross and creepy.
: I’m sorry for being gross and creepy, Io. I’ll try to do better in the future.
: That’s not what I-

: No, you’re right. All of this started because I couldn’t keep my stupid feelings in check, and now I have to deal with it for the rest of forever because I’m a disgusting pervert who bit off more than she could chew.
: Uta...

: Even today, I’m still like that. And I’d probably make the same stupid mistakes if I had never gotten burnt the first time around. That’s who I really am, Io. I’m gross. And I’m creepy. And I’m fucking sad.
: I am so fucking sad, Io.
: All I wanted was to feel cute and...pretty...and wanted. But I was none of those things and just the fact that I wanted them wound up ruining my brother’s life and mine.
: No one’s going to ever want me. Like, really want me. They’re going to find out what I’m all about and just pivot to thinking I’m a whore who chases after older dudes to feel validated.
: Like, look at me. I work at a maid cafe. I basically get paid to make people think about having sex with me. And the more they want it, the more I make. But that’s all they really want.
: The second it’s Uta and not Uta-chan, it’ll all come crashing down because Uta is a failure. She gave away her pride for temporary bliss, and now she’s got nothing left to give.
: I am so fucking sad.
: I am so fucking sad.
: I’d hug you if we weren’t naked right now...
: Hah...that felt good to get off my chest. It’s been a while since I’ve had my very own Io-style self-loathing session.
: Well, it didn’t feel good for me. I hate hearing you talk about yourself like that. And I hate that my inability to properly word things is what ultimately led to that happening.
: It was coming sooner or later, Io. It wasn’t your fault. Just have to...reset or something.
: Listen, this...
: I know I’ve said this a million times before and...I know you probably don’t believe me because, if you did, we wouldn’t keep coming back to it...but you’re wrong.
: You’re so wrong.
: Someone is going to love you for real one day because you’re amazing and strong and the fact that you’re able to put on a brave face after all that’s happened and still happens to you is insane.
: Sex is...it’s not as...I get that I look at it differently from most people. And I get that I’m the one who’s weird for doing that, not you. You’re totally normal and not creepy or gross at all.
: And if someone as fucking backwards as me can see that about you, someone else obviously will.
: In summation, I am very clearly not a person who has the right to tell anyone to stop self-deprecating when that very trait is roughly 50%% of my personality.
: But Uta, if I ever hear you talk down on yourself to that extent again, I am going to slap you so hard that you’re going to forget that naked pictures of you were ever leaked in the first place.
: Well, damn. If you have that power, just hit me now.
: If I really did have that power, you know I would.
: You’re the only person I’d do anything for, Uta. I mean that.
: Maybe a couple years ago, sure. But you’ve got Sensei now. It’s not just me anymore.
: I wouldn’t do anything for Sensei. If I would, there’d be no need for a throuple in the first place since I could just take one for the team and let him violate me.
: This conversation’s about to get weird, isn’t it?

: I’m telling you- it really is the best option for everyone. Plus, you probably wouldn’t think of yourself as such a pervert anymore if you were standing next to Sensei all the time as his powers far surpass yours.
: Calling them “powers” is all sorts of wrong when they are actively making my life a living hell.
: He could love the real you too, Uta. I know he could. Like, he puts up with me and I’m infinitely worse than you are.
: Maybe that’s what you’re missing? Or just...not understanding, I guess.
: You’ve got that right, Io...
: No, listen. It’s like...I know he could love you because it’s the broken people like us who work the best together.
: When you’ve got nothing left to give, natural instinct is to take, right? And who better to take from than someone who doesn’t realize how much they actually have?

: Both of you are like that. You think you’re all washed up and unworthy of anyone’s feelings, so you flail and you fumble until you’re so desperate for companionship that you’re talking to people like me.
: That’s probably why I fell for him in the first place. Like really fell for him. Because I saw pieces of you in there and they made me feel at home.
: At the end of the day, I can want and wish and hope for his approval until I’m old and gray...
: But I think you two would be a far better match than he and I ever would.
: Just because...we’re perverted? And broken and sad and stuff?
: Because I think you complement each other well. And that you can fill each other’s voids in a way that nobody else I’ve come across really can.
: Though, I also won’t deny that part of it might be because I can’t imagine anyone ever complementing me to that extent. I’m probably just better off alone, all things considered.
: To be honest, if you actually did have feelings for Sensei, my biggest fear would probably become the two of you leaving me since I know I’d have no purpose anymore.
: How could I leave you alone at this point in our lives? I need you just as much as you need me.
: But wouldn’t having someone else ease that burden a little? It’d be like walking with two crutches instead of just one. We could all lean on each other.
: Also, if you really spend as much time thinking about all of that “physical” stuff as you say you do, you might actually be able to sate his appetite.
: That’s just my opinion, though.
: You...
: You’ve really thought this through, huh?...
: It’s less “thinking it through” and more just a vibe. But the best outcome is never what either one of us ends up with, so this will probably always just be a pipe dream of mine.
: If your feelings ever change, though...and you do start to see Sensei in the same light that I do...
: Don’t let me be the barrier between you.
: Because I know you.
: And I know you would.
